title: claytonia litoralis
intro: Claytonia litoralis, commonly known as beach spring beauty or sea miner's lettuce, is a perennial plant species belonging to the purslane family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Claytonia litoralis are attributed to its ability to regulate blood sugar levels, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Claytonia litoralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
